decisions_recorded: onRegistration is NEW-guarded (CON-APP-002); registrations() and the C6b read accessors are unguarded read accessors (IR-APP-008 AC-1/AC-2, IR-ENGINE-003 AC-4).
Registration record uses getX accessors (IR-KT-001 value object rule); kind enum has exactly the ten 00 §8 constants.
Expanded Router/group records follow their ROUTER_MOUNT/GROUP record in the router's own order (FR-APP-026 AC-1).
socketAddress() and requestId() are non-null String (IR-HTTP-010); socketAddress() is the adapter string unnormalised (SEC-HTTP-001).
trustProxyHops(0) is accepted and means no trust; negative throws IllegalArgumentException (IR-ENGINE-003 AC-2).
All X-Forwarded-For header lines are combined in arrival order before right-to-left resolution (SEC-ENGINE-001 AC-3, SEC-ENGINE-002 AC-5).
trustProxy(boolean) stays, unchanged and not @Deprecated in 0.11.0 (CON-ENGINE-001 AC-4).
code_context correction applied: onError lambda is DefaultRestApp.java:942-945 (research cites 941-944), recorded in FR-APP-025 AC-6 and research.

open_questions: C4: what getMethod() and getTarget() hold for ROUTE, GROUP, STATIC, CORS and PARAM records, and whether a route(path) builder yields one record per method call (00 §8 silent). Left out of ACs; decide during implementation.
C4: public representation of a Pattern/array path (FR-APP-026 AC-5 only requires it be distinguishable).
C4: a Router mounted under two prefixes or into two apps; how late additions are reported (once per mount?).
C4: watcher that registers again from inside the watcher (re-entrancy), and whether later watchers still run after the first one throws.
C6b: behaviour when legacy trustProxy(true) and trustProxyHops/trustProxyCidrs are both set (last call wins or reject).
C6b: read accessor names and the 'unset' representation (00 gives no names).
C6b: whether trustProxyCidrs accepts a bare address without /prefix, and whether trustProxyCidrs() with no argument clears trust.
C6b hop mode: result when XFF has fewer than n entries, or blank/malformed entries.
C6b CIDR mode: result when every XFF entry is inside the trusted CIDRs; whether an IPv4-mapped IPv6 peer (::ffff:a.b.c.d) matches an IPv4 CIDR.
C6b XFP: case-insensitive comparison of 'https' and combination of several XFP header lines in hop/CIDR modes.
R32 runtime WARN 'XFF seen with no trust configured, once per run': assumed to be emitted by auth, not Core; confirm ownership with the AUTH writer.
Servlet: container-level forwarding (Tomcat RemoteIpValve, Jetty ForwardedRequestCustomizer) stacking with Core trust is documented as a pitfall only; whether Core should detect it is open.
